{{Top|leg}}
'''Merisee Dispatch''' was one of the three primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]]. It was located outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Caronath]]. It was a passenger facility with direct access to the city's medical facilities.
